function_def_model_needs_provider.name: function_def_model_needs_provider
function_def_model_needs_provider.value: "cosmos"."function_def"."model" is null or "cosmos"."function_def"."provider" is not null

sponsor_urls_https.name: sponsor_urls_https
sponsor_urls_https.value: ("engage"."sponsor"."link_url" is null or "engage"."sponsor"."link_url" ~ '^https://') and ("engage"."sponsor"."logo_light_url" is null or "engage"."sponsor"."logo_light_url" ~ '^https://') and ("engage"."sponsor"."logo_dark_url" is null or "engage"."sponsor"."logo_dark_url" ~ '^https://')

sponsor_dates.name: sponsor_dates
sponsor_dates.value: "engage"."sponsor"."ends_at" is null or "engage"."sponsor"."starts_at" is null or "engage"."sponsor"."ends_at" > "engage"."sponsor"."starts_at"

points_ledger_shape.name: points_ledger_shape
points_ledger_shape.value:
("fan"."points_ledger"."reason" = 'revert' and "fan"."points_ledger"."reverts_id" is not null and "fan"."points_ledger"."points_delta" <= 0 and "fan"."points_ledger"."balance_delta" <= 0)
        or ("fan"."points_ledger"."reason" = 'redeem' and "fan"."points_ledger"."reverts_id" is null and "fan"."points_ledger"."points_delta" = 0 and "fan"."points_ledger"."balance_delta" < 0)
        or ("fan"."points_ledger"."reason" not in ('revert', 'redeem') and "fan"."points_ledger"."reverts_id" is null and "fan"."points_ledger"."points_delta" > 0 and "fan"."points_ledger"."balance_delta" = "fan"."points_ledger"."points_delta")

profile_erased.name: profile_erased
profile_erased.value: ("fan"."profile"."deleted_at" is null and "fan"."profile"."external_profile_id" is not null) or ("fan"."profile"."deleted_at" is not null and "fan"."profile"."external_profile_id" is null and "fan"."profile"."nickname" is null and "fan"."profile"."avatar_url" is null)

moderation_sanction_hidden.name: moderation_sanction_hidden
moderation_sanction_hidden.value: not "engage"."moderation_sanction"."hidden" or ("engage"."moderation_sanction"."level" = 'mute' and "engage"."moderation_sanction"."ends_at" is not null)

tenant_override_value.name: tenant_override_value
tenant_override_value.value: ("billing"."tenant_override"."kind" in ('tier', 'addon')) = ("billing"."tenant_override"."value" is not null) and ("billing"."tenant_override"."value" is null or "billing"."tenant_override"."value" >= 0)

multisport.medal_table.definition:
with counts as (
      select e.games_id, m.noc_code,
        count(*) filter (where m.medal = 'G')::int as gold,
        count(*) filter (where m.medal = 'S')::int as silver,
        count(*) filter (where m.medal = 'B')::int as bronze,
        count(*)::int as total
      from multisport.medal m
      join multisport.event e on e.id = m.event_id
      where m.revoked_at is null
      group by e.games_id, m.noc_code
    )
    select games_id, noc_code, gold, silver, bronze, total,
      (rank() over (partition by games_id order by gold desc, silver desc, bronze desc))::int as rank_by_gold,
      (rank() over (partition by games_id order by total desc, gold desc, silver desc, bronze desc))::int as rank_by_total
    from counts
multisport.medal_table.name: medal_table
